outcome: lung function (blood gas analysis, spirometry, capnometry, chest radiographs)
cohort: The study included 27 preterm lambs, divided into four experimental groups based on exposure to antenatal dexamethasone and/or postnatal surfactant.
finding: Preterm lambs exhibited low vitality and impaired pulmonary function, with specific treatments (dexamethasone and surfactant) significantly influencing rectal temperature, tidal volume, and capnometry readings.
